subTitle: Take a break from CoBuddy.
point1: Your profile will be hidden from everyone.
point3: You can reactivate anytime by logging in.
profileHiddenSub: No one will be able to see your profile or book you.
pendingBookingsSub: Any active or upcoming bookings will remain active. You must complete or cancel them.
easyReactivationSub: Simply log back in at any time to automatically reactivate your account.
